subject.title: Gateway runtime: "no such table: plugin_state_entries / acp_sessions" despite tables existing in state/openclaw.sqlite (agent turns produce no reply)

question: Should maintainers treat merged PR 101881 as sufficient for this issue, or keep this as a distinct live-repro state-path bug until Docker path diagnostics are captured?
rationale: The current-main container-upgrade fix is plausibly adjacent, but the exact report says the tables already exist in the mounted DB and the same table errors persist on the beta image, so automation cannot safely close or patch without maintainer confidence in the root cause.

options.title: Keep Distinct Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted resolved DB paths, `PRAGMA database_list`, and gateway logs from the failing container before selecting a fix boundary.

options.title: Close As Covered By PR 101881
options.body: Close only if maintainers know the reporter's beta/stable images predate the merged startup checkpoint and that the checkpoint explains the observed table mismatch.

options.title: Sponsor Docker Repro Work
options.body: Have a maintainer or repair worker build a real Docker repro for gateway run, device-pair polling, `chat.history`, and `sessions.send` using the stated env/config shape.

recommendation.title: Keep Distinct Repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted resolved DB paths, `PRAGMA database_list`, and gateway logs from the failing container before selecting a fix boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-history owner for the shared SQLite path/opener and latest release boundary involved in the decision.
